{"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC."}],"comment":"The heat treatment specifies a hardness range but does not state at which manufacturing stage it applies (e.g., before or after final machining). This matters because machining a hardened part requires different tooling and process planning than machining soft stock. The designer should add the applicable stage to the heat treatment callout in the title block or note N1."
  , "recommended_correction": "Specify the manufacturing stage for the heat treatment, e.g., 'TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC AFTER ROUGH MACHINING'."}]}
